course.title: HTML Mastery
course.subtitle: Complete HTML and Web Structure Program
course.tagline: Build Structure. Write Semantics. Ship Accessible Pages.
course.description: HTML from the first document to semantic structure, accessible forms, metadata, embeds and a complete multi-page project. Twenty modules in six stages, ten learning sections each, with every sample written against the living HTML Standard and its rendered result recorded beside it.
course.standard: HTML Living Standard · HTML5 · WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices
prerequisites: No prior markup experience required — Module 01 starts from zero
A browser and a plain text editor (VS Code recommended)
outcomes: Explain how a browser parses HTML into the DOM and renders a page
Write a complete, valid HTML document from memory
Use headings, text, links, lists, images and tables correctly
Choose semantic landmarks instead of generic containers
Build labelled forms with native validation and correct submission
Embed audio, video and external content safely
Write metadata that controls search snippets and social cards
Make pages usable with a keyboard and a screen reader
Debug broken markup with developer tools and the W3C validator
Build a complete accessible multi-page website structure
